arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && cat > rssdrive.py <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, json, resource, sys, io, os
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("sub","/workspace/submission/main.py")
sub=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)
path=sys.argv[1]; cp=sys.argv[2]=="1"
reqs=[]; t=0
for f in range(4096): reqs.append({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0})
per=1000000//4096
for f in range(4096):
    sent=0
    while sent<per:
        ch=[]
        for _ in range(min(1024,per-sent)):
            t+=1; ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":t%2,"length":1+((t*7919)%2048)}); sent+=1
        reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})
if cp: reqs.append({"op":"checkpoint"})
data=""".join(""json)""" # placeholder
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
r0,w0=os.pipe(); r1,w1=os.pipe()
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
    os.close(w0); os.close(r1)
    os.dup2(r0,0); os.dup2(w1,1)
    devnull=os.open(os.devnull,os.O_WRONLY); os.dup2(devnull,2)
    os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,"-I","/workspace/submission/main.py","stream",path])
os.close(r0); os.close(w1)
os.write(w0,data); os.close(w0)
total=b""
while True:
    b=os.read(r1,1<<20)
    if not b: break
    total+=b
os.close(r1)
_,status,ru=os.wait4(pid,0)
print("checkpoint=%s status=%d out=%.2fMB peakrss=%.1fMB"%(cp,status,len(total)/1e6,ru.ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
D=$(ls -d /tmp/tmp.* 2>/dev/null | tail -1); echo "prog=$D"; ls $D
timeout 170 python3 rssdrive.py $D/p.json 0; timeout 170 python3 rssdrive.py $D/p.json 1
